references.text: God shows mercy to thousands of generations of those who love him, reflecting his compassion (רַחוּם) and grace (חַנּוּן) mentioned in Exodus 34:6
Moses quotes almost verbatim from Exodus 34:6 when he asks for forgiveness for the people of Israel: 'slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love' (אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד)
Describes the LORD as the faithful God who keeps his covenant and his steadfast love (חֶסֶד), corresponding to 'abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness'
Nehemiah quotes from this text: 'a God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love' (אֵל סְלִיחוֹת חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד)

David uses an almost identical formulation: 'Lord, you are a gracious and merciful God, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness' (אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת)
The psalm declares that 'the LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love' (רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד)
Reflects God's attributes: 'the LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love' (חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל־חָסֶד)
Joel quotes this text when he calls the people to repentance: 'he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love' (חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד)
Jonah quotes this text as the reason for his reluctance: 'you are a gracious and merciful God, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love' (אֵל חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד)
John describes Jesus as 'full of grace and truth' (πλήρης χάριτος καὶ ἀληθείας), which corresponds to the Hebrew חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת
Grace and truth (ἡ χάρις καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια) came through Jesus Christ, reflecting חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת from Exodus 34:6
James describes the Lord as 'rich in mercy and compassion' (πολύσπλαγχνός καὶ οἰκτίρμων), which reflects רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן
The direct contextual precursor where God's promise of revelation leads to the actual revelation of his name.
